svg.aria-label: The six questions metadata answers, plus the license check
svg.title: The six questions metadata should answer before you use a dataset

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Before you use a dataset, its metadata should answer six questions

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The same six you met in CCE 114. If you cannot answer one of them, you do not yet know whether the data fits your project.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What do the data represent, in what

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: format, and what does each attribute mean?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: CARTOCODE = '4' means nothing until you find

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its domain.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Where?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What area do they cover, and in which

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: coordinate system and units?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Web Mercator looks fine and measures 71%

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wrong in Utah.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: When were they collected, when last

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: updated, and how often are they revised?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2010 census blocks are not 2020 census

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tracts.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Why?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: What was the dataset made for in the first

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: place?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: A layer drawn for a road map is not an

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: engineering centerline.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: How were they collected, and what

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: processing came after?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Our roads extract was clipped and

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: repackaged; its README says exactly how.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Who?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Which organization maintains them, and who

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: do you contact when something looks wrong?

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: UGRC maintains Utah Roads. A stranger's copy

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: on ArcGIS Online is not a source.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: And the one that decides whether you may use it at all: the license.

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Public domain and CC BY (credit the source) are fine for this course. Anything that forbids redistribution, commercial use or

text.font-family: Segoe UI, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: derived products needs a second look before you build on it. If you cannot find a license at all, treat that as a no.
